publication.title: Semantic Web and Interactive Knowledge Graphs as an Educational Technology

source_reading.scope: Main §§1–8: ontology/instance model, complete five-step browser walkthrough, context-sensitive search, concrete Levenshtein/Pareto ranking, annotation workflow and conclusion; author/copyright page and cited prototype location inspected. No integral bibliography attestation.

adjudication.basis: The chapter describes an implemented semantic educational portal and RDF browser over nuclear training/course/professor/video entities. Search widgets lead to graph nodes; expandable property groups, relation labels, metadata and linked media support progressive instance/relation exploration. Separate context-search/annotation components link external resources to KG entities. Source-reported educational use lacks a recruited-user denominator or measured outcomes.

codes.notes: Actual domain KG instance and relation exploration is shown. Educational use and a few-minute learning claim have no participant or outcome denominator. Publisher chapter-specific peer-review label/dates are directly corroborated from the cached official landing page.

studies.cohort_note: Cross-report participant overlap is not established.
studies.design: Five-step worked example finding/validating a course’s lecture videos through professors/institutions and properties
studies.results: Prototype screens show instance/relation exploration and media access.
limitations: The claim that students learn it within a few minutes has no measurement protocol, participant count or comparative effect.

studies.cohort_note: Cross-report participant overlap is not established.
studies.design: Authors state actual use at National Research Nuclear University MEPhI
limitations: No adoption count, deployment duration, pedagogical outcome or task-performance denominator.

descriptions.interaction: Choose a nuclear KG; autocomplete a class/object; open the RDF browser; expand/collapse property/triple groups; inspect related nodes and metadata; hide alternatives and open linked lecture media. Annotation results can open the surrounding KG entities in the same browser.
descriptions.guidance: Prefix completion, typed relation-group tooltips and counts, contextual node metadata, and a ranked annotation list linking external resources to appropriate KG entities.
descriptions.visualisation: ["Node-link browser with grouped petals for triples", "Metadata panel", "Linked video/media", "Ranked annotation/result lists"]
descriptions.backend: OWL ontologies and RDF instances in nuclear-education knowledge graphs; explicit TBox/ABox distinction.

Separate context-search/annotation components link external resources to KG entities. Source-reported educational use lacks a recruited-user denominator or measured outcomes.
